'''Ted Panczyszyn''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Rogue 15 from Quakertown, Pennsylvania.<ref name="decsq-coruscant" /> His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He learned the game from Kendrick Summers at a June 1996 demo and built communities in Rochester, New York and Philadelphia. He went 5–1 at Origins 1999.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
